info.description:
Sourced estimates of US import duties and fees: every amount cites its official,
dated source. Informational use only, not a customs determination.

Send an API key of your workspace in `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Amounts are strings in US
dollars; `null` is unknown, never zero.

get.description:
The agreements the engine applies, by the symbol of the HTS special column, with the origins
each can apply to. A symbol does not establish eligibility: send it as preference, which
declares the rules of origin met. Needs the read permission; not counted.

example.condition: A symbol does not establish eligibility. Consult General Notes and the product's special column.

402.description: `access_required`: no active subscription; `quota_exceeded`: the quota is used up.

403.description: `forbidden`: the key lacks the permission, or the plan the API.

429.description: `rate_limited`: too many requests; wait the `Retry-After` seconds, until the window of `X-RateLimit-Reset`.

503.description: Unavailable for now: retry after `Retry-After` seconds. `service_unavailable` and `data_unavailable`, seconds; `edition_not_published`, the edition in effect on the date is not published yet: an hour, it can take longer; `billing_review`, the subscription needs support, without `Retry-After`: contact support. A batch is a 503 when every item meets it; when only some do, they have their error in `results`: send those items again.

post.description:
Every US duty and fee that applies to one product at a date, each with its official source.
Without a customs value, the duty rate. Not saved: an unsaved estimate cannot be replayed,
reported or notified in an incident; save it with POST /v1/saved-estimates. Needs the calculate
permission; counted in the quota unless it gives no figure of the duty: a question asked
without any duty amount or rate (status needs_information), a code the tariff does not have
or that names no product, a regime the service does not calculate. A question that gives the
duty of each answer (scenarios), their bounds or the subtotal already known is counted.

parameters.description: Makes a request safe to retry, after a timeout for instance. Send a new unique value with each request (a UUID). If no response comes back, send the same request again with the same key: within 7 days, you get the first response, and the request counts once. The same key with a different request is refused (409). An error response is not kept: the request sent again is calculated anew. A key belongs to its operation: on another route, it is a new key.

Each item calculated on its own, as POST /v1/estimates would, in the order given. An invalid item
refuses the whole batch (422, error.fields naming items.<index>.<field>); an item that cannot be
calculated (a date no edition covers) has its own error in results, the others are calculated.

amount or rate, and errors, only). When the data is unavailable for every item, the batch is a
503 to send again, neither counted nor kept for its Idempotency-Key; when only for some, they
have their error (data_unavailable) in results: send those items again.
